# Derived files — what dotagent generates

dotagent generates a small set of files that are pure views of authoritative state. They re-render on every `dotagent sync` / `dotagent project regenerate` / pre-commit-with-docs-change. Hand-editing is wasted — the next regen wipes it.

For the ownership boundary, see `CLAUDE_MD_DESIGN.md` § "The ownership rule." For what dotagent **does not** touch, see `HAND_MAINTAINED_DOCS_CONVENTION.md`.

---

## Generated files

| File | Source | Tier | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CLAUDE.md` + sister adapters | canonical schema + brief/plan/config | any | Navigation manifest the AI reads first |
| `.agent/git.md` | `.agent/git.yaml` | project-root | Human-readable branch policy dashboard |
| `.agent/project/SCOPE.md` | `plan.yaml` + brief | any with plan | Human-readable project blueprint |
| `.agent/project/CONTRACTS.md` | walking modules + cycles | any with modules | Per-repo contracts dashboard |
| `contracts.md` | aggregating sub-repos | project-root | Tier-1 cross-repo contracts rollup |
| `.agent/project/modules/<id>/PLAN.md` | `module.yaml` | any with modules | Human-readable module plan |
| `.agent/project/modules/<id>/cycles/<NN>/contract.frozen.md` | post-freeze snapshot | any with cycles | Immutable contract record |
| `docs/service-registry.md` | `.agent/git.yaml` `repos:` | project-root | Per-repo table (id · path · branch · role · remote) |
| `.agent/project/modules/<id>/HISTORY.md` | each module's cycles + completion | any with modules | Per-module cycle log, newest-first |
| `.agent/dashboard.md` | project state + episodic + doc mtimes | any | Single-page project health snapshot |

Every generated file carries a `<!-- generated by dotagent · <kind> · do not hand-edit -->` banner + `rendered-at:` timestamp.

---

## `docs/service-registry.md`

One row per service from `git.yaml` `repos:`: `id · path · default_branch · role · remote`. Project-root tier only; service-repo inherits via `../docs/service-registry.md`.

---

## `.agent/project/modules/<id>/HISTORY.md`

Per-module cycle log. Newest cycle on top. Status badges per cycle:

| Badge | Meaning |
|---|---|
| ✓ Passed QA | `qa_result.passed == True` |
| ✗ Failed QA | `qa_result.passed == False` |
| ⏳ Contract frozen | `contract.frozen_at` set, no QA result yet |
| ⏳ Dev handoff | `handoff_at` set, no QA result yet |
| 📝 Contract negotiation (round N/M) | Contract exists, not yet frozen |
| 🟢 In progress | Started, no contract yet |

Built from `Module` + cycle artifacts. Tier: any with modules.

---

## `.agent/dashboard.md`

Five sections, single page:

| Section | What |
|---|---|
| 📜 Open contracts | Modules whose current cycle has a contract + no QA pass yet |
| 🧪 Pending QA | Dev-handoff received, no QA result recorded |
| ⏰ Stalled (>14d) | Active cycles whose last activity is older than threshold |
| 📅 Doc staleness (>60d) | Canonical `docs/*.md` whose mtime is older than threshold |
| 📡 Recent activity | Last 10 events from episodic memory |

Tier: any. Project-root surfaces project-wide state; service-repo surfaces service-local state (loaded `Project` is service-scoped). Service-repo also gets an inherited pointer to `../.agent/dashboard.md` for the cross-service rollup.

---

## Wiring

All generators run through `regenerate_derived_files()` in `src/dotagent/render/derived.py`. Call sites:

| Call site | When |
|---|---|
| `dotagent sync` | After adapter regen |
| `dotagent project regenerate` | Explicit |
| `dotagent observe pre-commit` | When staged files include `docs/*.md` |

**Fail-soft:** each generator is wrapped in try/except. One failing never blocks the others. Failures land in `.agent/log/`.

**Safe to call from any state:** no `.agent/` → returns empty; no `git.yaml` → skips service-registry; no `plan.yaml` → skips HISTORY + dashboard.

---

## Known limitations

1. **No partial regen.** Each generator re-renders its full output. Sub-second on typical projects.
2. **No diff preview.** `dotagent project regenerate --dry-run` shows paths, not diffs.
3. **No auto-staging.** Regenerated files land on disk but aren't `git add`-ed.
4. **No dashboard history.** Each render overwrites. Episodic memory holds history.
